question: Which podcast host is buying strangers entire baby registries?
story: Alex Cooper is walking into strangers' baby registries and buying every single thing on them. According to TMZ, the Call Her Daddy host has spent the past week reposting fans' registries to her Instagram story and then quietly clearing them out. Cribs. Car seats. Strollers. Entire lists, gone. Followers have reportedly been posting screenshots showing everything marked as purchased, then thanking her for it. Here is the context that makes it land. Cooper announced her own pregnancy back in May and is expecting her first child with her husband, Matt Kaplan, and she has spent months openly asking her audience for advice about becoming a mom. So she is buying for the exact people who have been coaching her through it. Sources reportedly say the requests are coming in faster than she can keep up with, and that she is trying to help as many families as she can. And she reportedly is not done yet.
